verdict.rationale: Docs confirm both versioned pinnable model IDs and '-latest' aliases that move on release, with the alias-to-version relationship explicitly called out in release notes (e.g. '-latest' now points to a newer model) and a standing deprecations page tracking shutdown dates per model. This directly matches the story of pinning exact versions while aliases track latest, with documented policy. Missing for 10: a single consolidated policy doc explicitly titled/dedicated to alias-versioning semantics (rather than inferred from changelog entries) and independent/community corroboration of this specific behavior.
